'''Melicoste's bunker''' was a bunker in the [[Carbonite Prisoner Storage]] area of the [[Minimum Security Section]], a region in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Belsavis prison|prison complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], that was taken over by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Melicoste]] during the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Invasion of Belsavis|invasion]] of the planet.
